highlights: Ferments: list what went in — from a planting (no pick needed), a pick, an earlier put-up (it comes off that jar or bag) or just a name — with grams, brand, fresh, frozen or dried, and a note; what came from your garden is marked.
Salt: dry, brine or salted then rinsed, as a percent of the veg, the veg and water, or the water, with the grams worked out; more than one salt step for kimchi.

Jar or crock and its size, roughly how much went in, an estimated heat (est. SHU) for the batch and each bottle, check-ins with Topped up brine, Pushed it back under and Skimmed the top, and every step editable afterwards, including after bottling.
